_description: Known HIGH/CRITICAL vulnerabilities pending major framework upgrades. Each entry must have a tracked remediation and a target_date. Review monthly and remove entries as they are fixed. Adding an entry here means committing to a remediation plan — it is NOT a permanent exemption.

_sla.high: 30 days from discovery; entries here have an approved extension

advisories: CVE-2025-68470 — Open redirect via backslash in <Link> and useNavigate
GHSA-337j-9hxr-rhxg — Arbitrary Constructor Injection via deserializeErrors() in SSR hydration
entries.scope: production — react-router-dom is a direct runtime dependency
entries.reason: CVE-2025-68470 is a real open-redirect risk for SPA use. GHSA-337j-9hxr-rhxg only affects SSR hydration (deserializeErrors); this app is a pure SPA (no SSR), so that advisory has no runtime impact. Fix requires react-router-dom@7.18.4 (semver non-major but flagged as breaking by npm audit --force).
entries.remediation: Upgrade react-router-dom to 7.18.4. Verify all <Link> usages, useNavigate calls, and router config are compatible with the new version. Run full E2E Playwright suite after upgrade.
